summary: Full-stack regression for SEO package + persistent image uploads + PWA + SEO Dashboard. All 14 pytest cases PASSED (public endpoints, sitemap.xml with image tags, robots.txt, seo meta, image upload → emergent storage + immediate GET, legacy migrated image /api/uploads/00cc5a9062f84ce5aacbf51df61cac9e.jpg still 200, admin/seo/overview, admin/seo/apps, bulk-fix, auto-generate, auth protection). Frontend E2E PASSED for homepage (55 apps rendered, exactly 1 title/canonical/og:title/og:url/og:description/description/robots — no duplicates), rumble-rummy detail (breadcrumbs data-testid=breadcrumbs visible, exactly 3 JSON-LD scripts SoftwareApplication+BreadcrumbList+FAQPage, canonical=https://uonogamesapk.com/rumble-rummy, robots=index,follow,max-image-preview:large,max-snippet:-1), SEO Dashboard (score 100%, 55 rows, 55 Auto-Fill buttons, bulk-fix returns Fixed 0/55 = already complete), Add New App dialog exposes form-focus-keyword + form-og-image + form-noindex.

issues: No JSON-LD is emitted on the homepage. SEOHead only pushes JSON-LD when app/breadcrumbs/faqItems props are provided; Store.jsx passes none. This satisfies 'no duplicates' but the homepage would benefit from a WebSite (with SearchAction) and Organization schema for richer Google results.

action_items: OPTIONAL / MINOR: Emit a WebSite + Organization JSON-LD on the homepage from Store.jsx (or extend SEOHead to auto-emit one when no app/breadcrumbs/faqItems are supplied). Currently the homepage has 0 JSON-LD scripts — this is not a duplicate/regression bug, just a missed SEO opportunity.

OPTIONAL: PWAInstallBanner relies on the browser's beforeinstallprompt event, which does not fire in the headless test browser and only fires on Chromium with an active service worker + engagement heuristics. Component wiring (data-testid=pwa-install-banner) is correct; visual verification of the banner requires a real device or Chromium with a registered SW. No SW file is registered — consider adding a minimal service worker if you want the install prompt to appear reliably on production.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py has grown to 1400+ lines mixing auth, apps, SEO, blog, reviews, winners, codes, media, backup, analytics, settings, faqs and seed data in one module. Split into routers/ modules (apps.py, seo.py, admin_seo.py, media.py, cms.py, etc.) — safe & non-breaking, will help future maintainability.

SEOHead.cleanupDuplicates runs on 5 timeouts (50/250/800/2000/4000ms) after every render. That is defensive but noisy — a MutationObserver on <head> scoped to og:/canonical selectors would be cleaner and cheaper.
Homepage SEOHead does not pass an `app`, `breadcrumbs`, or `faqItems` so no JSON-LD is emitted at all — consider emitting a default WebSite/Organization schema when those props are absent.

backend /api/admin/media walks the local UPLOAD_DIR only; uploads made via Emergent Object Storage will NOT appear in the Media Library grid. Media list should be sourced from object storage (or a MongoDB media collection) to reflect actual uploads.
